crossRefs.note: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the…
Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

translations.web: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
translations.bsb: After Jesus had left the crowd and gone into the house, His disciples inquired about the parable.
translations.kjv: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
translations.asv: And when he was entered into the house from the multitude, his disciples asked of him the parable.
